data.completion_memo: Implemented all six native managed-job tools, Settings admission, frozen bindings and normal broker approval. Ordinary shell yields within at most 10 seconds when its four job controls are bound; existing frozen Chats without controls preserve bounded legacy behavior. Chat-owned registry persists launch identity before side effects, acknowledges output cursors only after broker outcome commit, never replays interrupted jobs, and restores post-snapshot output sizes on restart. Bounded running capacity/output/history; native sessions released on terminal state. Tests: 4 native registry cases pass (ownership, launch dedup, retention, Stop, restart/no replay, durable cursor and crash output); six catalog tests pass; desktop suite 345 passed before the additional crash-output case. Native projectless Chat fixture passes with real Windows shell processes. No Adashi QA changes.
data.description: Implement shell_start, job_output, job_input, job_stop, job_list and approval-protected job_keep; ordinary shell yields into the shared engine. Persist job identity/state/output cursors and recover without replay. Enforce owner isolation, normal authorization, projectless execution, capacity and shutdown cleanup. Exclude Adashi QA.
data.title: Expose durable Chat-owned shell jobs and control tools
